crossRefs.note: Now Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said to his sons, “Why do you look at one another?”
They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”
They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”
They began to question among themselves, which of them it was who would do this thing.

translations.web: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.
translations.bsb: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed as to which of them He meant.
translations.kjv: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
translations.asv: The disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
